summary: Previously recorded Perplexity startup terms: $5,000 in API credits plus Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats; raised up to $20M in equity funding, less than 5 years old, associated with an approved Startup Partner, and not an existing Enterprise Pro customer. The recorded startup URL still redirects to the generic /hub page (rechecked 2026-10-22). Perplexity's Typeform application (titled 'Startups (2025)') remains public; its metadata says 6 months of Enterprise Pro and $5,000 in Sonar API credits, while the 2026-09-27 official-page snapshot said 3 months. Whether applications are still reviewed and which term applies needs provider confirmation.
claim_steps: The recorded https://www.perplexity.ai/startups/ URL redirects to /hub (rechecked 2026-10-22); it is not a confirmed current program page.

Perplexity's Typeform at https://perplexity.typeform.com/startups-apply remains public. It asks for a company email, your Perplexity API Group ID, website, headcount, equity funding raised and your Startup Partner.
Before applying, confirm the previously recorded eligibility: ≤$20M equity funding (grants excluded), <5 years old, approved Startup Partner association, and no existing Enterprise Pro subscription.
The form metadata says 6 months of Enterprise Pro; the 2026-09-27 official page said 3 months. Ask startups@perplexity.ai or your partner for written current terms before relying on either.
YC alumni are routed to Bookface deals instead of this form.
